headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, driven by AI‑related sales.
summary: Most major players reported double‑digit YoY revenue gains. TCS and HCLTech confirmed strong operating margins and expanding AI revenue. Mid‑tier firms such as L&T Technology Services and Tech Mahindra also posted healthy top‑line growth. Several companies (Infosys, OFSS, Persistent, Coforge, Mphasis) have not released full results yet.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI revenue grew sharply across the sector, with HCLTech up 78% YoY and LTM up 47% YoY. TCS crossed the $3 bn annual AI revenue mark.

themes.title: Dividend continuity
themes.detail: Most firms maintained or raised interim dividends, signalling confidence in cash flow.

leaders.why: Highest YoY revenue growth at ~20% and strong AI‑led service wins.
Largest revenue base with 24% operating margin and 10% AI contribution.

laggards.why: Revenue grew 30% YoY but net profit fell 25% QoQ, indicating margin pressure.
Revenue growth slowed to 9% YoY and net profit declined 1.9% YoY.
